subject: geography
title: The water cycle and rivers
objective: Trace water through the cycle and along a river.

lesson.opening: Water moves endlessly between ocean, air, and land. Rivers are the visible part of that journey.

sections.heading: The cycle
sections.body: The Sun evaporates water; it condenses into clouds; precipitation falls; water runs off or soaks in; and it eventually returns to the ocean.

sections.heading: A river’s course
sections.body: A river begins at a source, gathers tributaries, flows through a watershed, and ends at a mouth, often building a delta.

sections.heading: Why it matters
sections.body: The water cycle supplies fresh water, shapes land, and links climate to rivers.
